Metadata.title: Takineo
Metadata.description: Focused English speaking practice with human teachers and AI-assisted feedback

Home.title: Focused speaking practice with human teachers and AI-assisted feedback
Home.description: Takineo is built around focused 15-minute English speaking sessions, where teachers teach and AI supports analysis and improvement.

Onboarding.title: How will you use Takineo?
Onboarding.description: Choose the workspace that matches your role. This selection creates your initial profile.
Onboarding.studentDescription: Find teachers, book 15-minute speaking sessions, and receive personalized feedback.
Onboarding.teacherDescription: Create a professional application, upload a short introduction video, and submit it for Takineo review.
Onboarding.selectionHint: Your initial role determines your workspace and the next onboarding steps.

StudentDashboard.description: Manage your learner profile and upcoming speaking sessions from one focused workspace.

StudentProfile.title: Tell us about your learning goals
StudentProfile.description: This information will help Takineo recommend suitable teachers and speaking sessions.
StudentProfile.goalPlaceholder: For example: I want to speak confidently in professional meetings and improve my everyday vocabulary.

TeacherProfile.title: Create your professional teaching profile
TeacherProfile.description: Students will later use this information to understand your teaching experience and approach.
TeacherProfile.headline: Professional headline
TeacherProfile.headlinePlaceholder: For example: English speaking coach for intermediate learners
TeacherProfile.bioPlaceholder: Describe your experience, teaching approach, preferred learners, and the speaking skills you focus on.
TeacherProfile.lockedPendingDescription: Your application is under review. Profile editing is locked until Takineo completes the review.
TeacherProfile.lockedApprovedDescription: This approved profile is locked to preserve the reviewed information associated with your teacher account.
TeacherProfile.lockedSuspendedDescription: This teacher profile is suspended. Profile editing remains locked while the suspension is active.
TeacherProfile.lockedPendingFootnote: If Takineo requests changes during review, your application will return to an editable state before resubmission.
TeacherProfile.lockedApprovedFootnote: Profile editing remains unavailable while this approved review snapshot is active.
TeacherProfile.lockedSuspendedFootnote: Profile editing remains unavailable while the teacher suspension is active.

TeacherVideo.title: Record your introduction video
TeacherVideo.description: Help students understand your personality, speaking style, and teaching approach before they choose a session.
TeacherVideo.statusMissing: No introduction video has been uploaded.
TeacherVideo.statusUploadPending: Choose a file and complete the upload.
TeacherVideo.statusProcessing: Your upload is complete and the video is being processed.
TeacherVideo.statusReadyForReview: Your video meets the duration requirement and is ready for Takineo review.
TeacherVideo.statusApproved: Your introduction video has been approved.
TeacherVideo.statusRejected: Your video needs to be replaced before you can submit the application.

TeacherVideo.durationRejected: The processed video is outside the required 60–120 second duration. Please replace it.
TeacherVideo.reviewFeedbackUnavailable: Takineo requested a new video, but no detailed reviewer feedback is available for this review.

TeacherVideo.requirementContent: Introduce yourself, your experience, your teaching approach, and the students you work best with.
TeacherVideo.requirementLanguage: Speak naturally in English for a meaningful part of the video.
TeacherVideo.requirementConsent: Upload only a video of yourself that you have permission to publish on your teacher profile.
TeacherVideo.uploadError: The video upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
TeacherVideo.createUploadError: Takineo could not prepare the video upload.
TeacherVideo.providerUnavailable: The video provider has not been configured for this environment.

TeacherVideo.applicationLocked: This application cannot currently be edited.

TeacherVideo.statusSaveError: The upload completed, but Takineo could not save the processing state. Your video has not been lost.

TeacherApplicationSubmit.title: Submit your teaching application
TeacherApplicationSubmit.description: Complete your professional profile and introduction video before sending your application to Takineo for review.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.confirmation: Submit your teaching application for review? Your profile and introduction video will be locked while the application is under review.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.profileIncomplete: Complete your professional profile before submitting.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.videoMissing: Upload your introduction video before submitting.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.videoNotReady: Your introduction video must finish processing and meet the video requirements before submission.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.submitError: Takineo could not submit your application.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.networkError: The connection was interrupted. Please try again.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.pendingDescription: Your professional profile and introduction video are temporarily locked while Takineo reviews your application.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.approvedDescription: Your teaching access is active. Approved teachers can use Takineo teacher features as they become available.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.rejectedProfileDescription: Takineo reviewed your application and requested changes to your professional profile. Review the feedback below, update the relevant information, then resubmit when your application is ready.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.rejectedVideoDescription: Takineo reviewed your application and requested changes that include your introduction video. Review the feedback below and update the required application items before resubmitting.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.reviewerFeedbackUnavailable: Takineo requested changes, but no detailed feedback is available for this review. Update the required application items or contact support before resubmitting.
TeacherApplicationSubmit.suspendedDescription: Your teaching access and public teacher visibility are currently paused. Contact Takineo support if you need help understanding the next steps.

AdminDashboard.title: A focused workspace for trusted operations
AdminDashboard.description: Takineo administration keeps teacher review and operational controls behind a dedicated, server-protected access boundary.
AdminDashboard.reviewDescription: Open the protected queue to review pending submissions in oldest-first order. Each submission includes a detailed review workspace with private video playback and guarded approve/reject decisions.
AdminDashboard.reviewBoundary: Queue, detail, playback, review decisions, and teacher suspension remain server-authorized. Teacher suspension is restricted to super admins and stays separate from broader account moderation and admin-access management.
AdminDashboard.accessDescription: Administrative access is checked on the server independently from student or teacher product roles before this workspace renders.
AdminDashboard.accessNote: Interface visibility never grants administrative permission.

AdminReviewQueue.title: Pending teacher applications
AdminReviewQueue.description: Review the oldest pending submissions first. Open a submission to inspect its profile and submitted snapshot, request private playback, and make a guarded review decision.
AdminReviewQueue.emptyDescription: There are no pending teacher applications in this page of the queue.

AdminModerationIndex.title: Approved and suspended teachers
AdminModerationIndex.description: Find teachers whose approved access can be suspended or restored. This workspace is restricted to super admins and keeps teacher access moderation separate from account moderation.
AdminModerationIndex.emptyApprovedDescription: There are no approved teachers on this page of the moderation index.
AdminModerationIndex.emptySuspendedDescription: There are no suspended teachers on this page of the moderation index.

AdminReviewDetail.title: Application — {name}
AdminReviewDetail.description: Review the current teacher profile and submission snapshot, use private playback when eligible, record pending review decisions, and manage teacher suspension when your permission and the current state allow it.
AdminReviewDetail.noVideo: No introduction video is attached to this application.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackDescription: Request a short-lived private player only when you are ready to review this introduction video. The playback grant is issued on demand and expires automatically.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackExpiresSoon: The signed grant expires automatically within five minutes.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackExpired: This private playback grant expired. Request a fresh grant to continue reviewing.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackUnavailableState: Private playback is unavailable because this application or its submitted video is no longer in an eligible, unchanged review state.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackUnauthorized: Your session is no longer available. Sign in again before requesting playback.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackForbidden: Your administrative access no longer permits private review playback.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackConflict: The application or submitted video changed. Reload the detail page before continuing the review.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackUnavailable: Private playback is temporarily unavailable. Try again without changing the review state.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackGenericError: Private playback could not be loaded. Try again.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionDescription: Decisions are submitted against the exact review cycle, profile revision, and video revision shown on this page. If the application changes first, the server rejects the decision as stale.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionUnavailable: Review decisions are unavailable because this application is no longer pending or its submitted snapshot is no longer aligned.
AdminReviewDetail.approveDescription: Approve the submitted profile and introduction video and make this teacher eligible for the approved-teacher workflow. This decision is audited.
AdminReviewDetail.approveUnavailable: Approval is unavailable unless the account is active, the profile is complete, and the submitted review snapshot is still aligned.
AdminReviewDetail.rejectDescription: Choose exactly what failed review and provide a specific reason for every rejected area. The applicant can use these reasons to prepare a corrected submission.
AdminReviewDetail.profileReasonPlaceholder: Explain what must change in the teacher profile.
AdminReviewDetail.videoReasonPlaceholder: Explain what must change in the introduction video.
AdminReviewDetail.rejectionReasonHint: Reasons must be specific and between 3 and 2,000 characters. Only the reasons required by the selected rejection target are submitted.
AdminReviewDetail.rejectionTargetRequired: Choose whether the rejection applies to the profile, video, or both.
AdminReviewDetail.profileReasonRequired: Enter a profile rejection reason of at least 3 characters.
AdminReviewDetail.videoReasonRequired: Enter a video rejection reason of at least 3 characters.
AdminReviewDetail.approveSuccess: Application approved. Refreshing the review state…
AdminReviewDetail.rejectSuccess: Application rejected. Refreshing the review state…
AdminReviewDetail.decisionUnauthorized: Your session is no longer available. Sign in again before making a review decision.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionForbidden: Your administrative access no longer permits this review decision.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionConflict: The application changed or was already decided. Reload the page before making another decision.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionInvalidRequest: The review decision was not accepted. Check the selected target and reasons, then try again.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionGenericError: The review decision could not be saved. No success is assumed; reload the page before trying again.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationDescription: Teacher suspension is separate from application review. Only super admins can change approved-teacher access, and every change is audited with a required reason.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationRestricted: Teacher suspension and reinstatement require super-admin access.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationUnavailable: No teacher-access transition is available for this application state. Reinstatement additionally requires an active account and an approved introduction video.
AdminReviewDetail.suspendDescription: Suspension removes this teacher from approved-teacher eligibility and queues public playback revocation. It does not change the user's account moderation state.
AdminReviewDetail.reinstateDescription: Reinstatement returns this teacher application to approved status and queues public playback enablement. The target account must still be active.
AdminReviewDetail.suspendReasonPlaceholder: Explain why teacher access must be suspended.
AdminReviewDetail.reinstateReasonPlaceholder: Explain why teacher access can be reinstated.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationReasonHint: Give a specific reason between 3 and 2,000 characters. The reason is stored with the administrative audit event.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationReasonRequired: Enter a moderation reason between 3 and 2,000 characters.
AdminReviewDetail.suspendSuccess: Teacher suspended. Refreshing the current state…
AdminReviewDetail.reinstateSuccess: Teacher reinstated. Refreshing the current state…
AdminReviewDetail.moderationUnauthorized: Your session is no longer available. Sign in again before changing teacher access.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationForbidden: Your administrative access no longer permits teacher moderation.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationConflict: The teacher application changed or this transition is no longer valid. Reload the page before trying again.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationInvalidRequest: The moderation change was not accepted. Check the reason and current state, then try again.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationGenericError: The moderation change could not be confirmed. No success is assumed; reload the page before trying again.

TeacherDiscovery.title: Find a teacher for your next conversation
TeacherDiscovery.description: Browse Takineo teachers and compare the next speaking openings currently projected by the schedule.
TeacherDiscovery.advisory: Next-available times are a live preview, not a reservation. The final slot is rechecked when a booking is created.
TeacherDiscovery.experienceYears: {years, plural, =1 {# year of teaching experience} other {# years of teaching experience}}
TeacherDiscovery.noAvailability: No opening in the current booking window
TeacherDiscovery.emptyTitle: No teachers are available to show right now
TeacherDiscovery.emptyDescription: Takineo could not find a teacher to show in the current booking window. Try again later as teacher availability changes.
TeacherDiscovery.loadErrorDescription: We could not verify the current teacher list. Try again to load a fresh discovery page.
TeacherDiscovery.loadMoreError: More teachers could not be loaded. Try again.

TeacherAvailability.title: Publish your speaking availability
TeacherAvailability.description: Set your recurring weekly windows and one-off changes. Takineo rechecks every write on the server before it becomes authoritative.
TeacherAvailability.loadErrorDescription: Takineo could not verify your current schedule. No editable state is assumed until a fresh server snapshot is loaded.
TeacherAvailability.lockedDescription: Your current teacher state does not allow availability management. Editing stays disabled until Takineo confirms that your account is eligible again.
TeacherAvailability.weeklyDescription: Build the complete recurring schedule you want to publish. Multiple windows can be added to a day; Takineo validates the complete schedule when you save.
TeacherAvailability.replacementNotice: Saving replaces the complete recurring weekly schedule with exactly the windows shown here. Removing every window and saving clears recurring availability.
TeacherAvailability.weeklySaveSuccess: Your recurring weekly schedule was saved and refreshed from Takineo.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionsTitle: Open or block a specific date
TeacherAvailability.exceptionsDescription: Add an extra opening or block time for a date in the current booking window. These records are stored separately from the recurring schedule.
TeacherAvailability.finishWeeklyFirst: Save or reset your weekly draft before changing one-off exceptions, so a server refresh cannot discard unsaved weekly edits.
TeacherAvailability.notePlaceholder: For example: appointment or extra evening hours
TeacherAvailability.noExceptions: No one-off changes are recorded in this booking window.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionCreateSuccess: The one-off availability change was created and the schedule was refreshed.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionDeleteSuccess: The one-off availability change was deleted and the schedule was refreshed.
TeacherAvailability.precedenceNotice: One-off openings and blocks may overlap. Takineo calculates final availability on the server; a block wins where one-off rules overlap.

errors.network: Takineo could not be reached. No schedule change is assumed; try again.
errors.invalidResponse: Takineo returned an unexpected availability response. No change is assumed; reload the authoritative schedule before continuing.
errors.invalidRequest: The schedule change was rejected. Review the fields and times, then submit the complete desired schedule again.
errors.range: The availability date range was rejected by Takineo. Reload the editor to request a fresh supported range.
errors.security: Takineo could not verify this browser mutation as a trusted application request. Reload the app before trying again.
errors.unavailable: This account cannot access teacher availability right now.
errors.exceptionNotFound: That one-off change no longer exists in your current schedule. The authoritative schedule has been refreshed.
errors.conflict: Your availability changed at the same time elsewhere. Takineo refreshed the authoritative schedule; review it before making another change.
errors.generic: The availability change could not be confirmed. No success is assumed; review the current server state and try again.
errors.refreshFailed: The mutation finished but Takineo could not refresh the authoritative schedule. Reload before making another availability change.

UpcomingSessions.title: Upcoming sessions
UpcomingSessions.description: Your confirmed speaking schedule, shown in Tehran time.
UpcomingSessions.emptyDescription: When a speaking session is scheduled, it will appear here with its confirmed time and participant.
UpcomingSessions.loadErrorDescription: We could not retrieve your current session list. Try again to see the latest schedule.
UpcomingSessions.loadMoreError: We could not load more sessions. Try again.
UpcomingSessions.cancelStudentDescription: Takineo will confirm the cancellation before changing this session. If it can no longer be cancelled, the session will stay unchanged.
UpcomingSessions.cancelTeacherDescription: Takineo will confirm the cancellation before changing this session. Teachers must include a reason.
UpcomingSessions.reasonRequired: Enter a cancellation reason before continuing.
UpcomingSessions.rebookDescription: The cancelled session stays cancelled. Choosing another time starts a separate new booking.
UpcomingSessions.bookAnotherTime: Choose another time with this teacher
UpcomingSessions.invalidSessionData: This session response does not match the expected participant contract. Refresh and try again.

errors.cutoff: This session can no longer be cancelled under the current cancellation policy.
errors.started: This session has already started, so it can no longer be cancelled.
errors.stateChanged: The session state changed before cancellation completed. Refresh the list and review its current state.
errors.conflict: Another session change happened at the same time. Review the current session state and try again if appropriate.
errors.stale: This session is no longer available in its previous state. Refresh your sessions.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to cancel this session.
errors.invalidRequest: The cancellation request was rejected. Review the information and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach Takineo. The session is still shown as scheduled; try again.
errors.generic: The session could not be cancelled. Its current schedule remains unchanged.
errors.invalidResponse: Takineo could not confirm the cancellation result. The session remains unchanged.

StudentBooking.loadingProfile: Loading teacher profile and current slots…
StudentBooking.bioFallback: This teacher has not added a public biography yet.
StudentBooking.authorityTitle: Availability is rechecked when you book
StudentBooking.authorityDescription: These times come directly from Takineo’s booking service, but another booking or schedule change can make a displayed slot unavailable before confirmation.
StudentBooking.slotsDescription: Select one of the currently projected Tehran-time slots. Your booking exists only after Takineo confirms a persisted scheduled session.
StudentBooking.slotsLoadErrorTitle: Current slots could not be verified
StudentBooking.slotsLoadErrorDescription: Takineo could not load the authoritative slot list. Try again before selecting a time.
StudentBooking.noSlotsTitle: No bookable times are available right now
StudentBooking.noSlotsDescription: This teacher has no authoritative opening in the current booking window. Availability can change as schedules and bookings change.
StudentBooking.confirmedDescription: Takineo confirmed a scheduled session for {time}.
StudentBooking.teacherUnavailableTitle: This teacher is no longer available to book
StudentBooking.teacherUnavailableDescription: The profile may have changed since discovery. Return to the teacher list for a fresh, server-verified option.
StudentBooking.profileLoadErrorTitle: Teacher profile could not be verified
StudentBooking.profileLoadErrorDescription: Takineo could not load a fresh public profile. Try again before choosing a time.

networkRetry.title: The booking result is not confirmed yet
networkRetry.description: The response was interrupted or could not be verified. Retry the same attempt so Takineo can safely recover the same durable booking if it already succeeded.

slotUnavailable.title: That time is no longer available
slotUnavailable.description: Takineo refreshed the authoritative slots. Choose a new time from the updated list.

bookingConflict.title: The schedule changed while you were booking
bookingConflict.description: Takineo refreshed the authoritative slots after a concurrent booking conflict. Choose a fresh time before trying again.

idempotencyConflict.title: This booking attempt can no longer be reused
idempotencyConflict.description: Takineo refreshed the authoritative slots. Select a time again to begin a genuinely new booking attempt with a new request key.

limitExceeded.title: You have reached the upcoming-session limit
limitExceeded.description: Takineo cannot accept another booking for this account right now. Review your upcoming sessions before booking again.

studentIneligible.title: This account cannot book student sessions right now
studentIneligible.description: Your current account state is not eligible for student booking. Takineo’s server remains the authority for booking access.

selfBooking.title: You cannot book your own teacher profile
selfBooking.description: Choose a different teacher for your speaking session.

authRequired.title: Sign in before confirming a booking
authRequired.description: Teacher profiles and slots are public, but creating a speaking session requires an authenticated active student account.

untrustedOrigin.title: Takineo could not verify this booking request
untrustedOrigin.description: The secure booking request was rejected. Reload Takineo from its normal application address before trying again.

invalidRequest.title: This booking selection could not be submitted
invalidRequest.description: The selected request no longer matches the booking contract. Reload the profile and select a fresh authoritative slot.

internalError.title: Takineo could not confirm the booking result
internalError.description: A server error interrupted confirmation. Retrying the same attempt preserves the same request key and cannot turn it into a different booking.
